project: BANA 212 Team 6: El Niño in the TAO buoy record, NOAA's ONI and Los Angeles winter rain
notebook: elnino_analysis_v4.ipynb, sections 11-12; sections 1-10 are the results frozen on 2026-11-22 (data/summary.json)
target: ONI phase of month t+k: El Niño if ONI >= +0.5, La Niña if ONI <= -0.5, otherwise Neutral

live_models.settings: fixed settings of sections 7 and 9 (the frozen results); the tuning in section 11 is reported only
live_models.setup: forecast issued at the start of month t+1 from the buoy anomalies of month t and the latest ONI (month t-1); anomalies vs each buoy's calendar-month mean over 1996-2025
live_models.training_window: issue months 1996-01 to 2025-12 with targets up to 2025-12, months with >= 5 buoys: the last walk-forward year's training data (section 9.5), so the logistic models reproduce the section 9.6 outlook

tuning.scoring: balanced accuracy over all validation months pooled across expanding-window folds by year
tuning.tie_break: first best setting in grid order: smaller C; fewer, shallower trees with larger leaves
tuning.conclusion: The cross-validated choice varied across windows and did not consistently beat the fixed settings on held-out years (tuned better in only 1 of 18 model–horizon comparisons), so the final models keep the fixed settings used in the report.

evaluations.main_split: train issue months <= 1994, test Jan 1995 - Jun 1998
evaluations.walk_forward: each test year 1999-2026 refitted on the 30 years before it; tuned setting from the first window
